title: Joseph - From Slave to Ruler
introduction: Joseph is one of the Bible's finest examples of God's providence. Sold as a slave by his brothers, thrown into prison in Egypt—but God was with him and elevated him to become the second most powerful man in Egypt. His life shows that God can turn evil into good.

sections.title: The Dreamer
sections.description: Joseph had dreams that hinted at his future greatness.

sections.title: Sold by His Brothers
sections.description: His brothers sold Joseph as a slave to Egypt.

sections.title: The Lord Was With Joseph
sections.description: Even as a slave and prisoner, the Lord was with Joseph and blessed him.

sections.title: Elevation
sections.description: God elevated Joseph to become Egypt's prime minister.

sections.title: Evil Turned to Good
sections.description: Joseph forgave his brothers and saw God's hand in all that had happened.
